newsitem.title: UK: Ashquay makes offer for UK estates.
newsitem.headline: Ashquay makes offer for UK estates.

text.p: Britain's Ashquay Group Plc said on Thursday that it was making an offer for UK Estates which valued the company at 21.1 million stg.
Ashquay is offering 10 offer shares for every 13 UK Estates ordinary shares.
The company said the offer represented a value of 35p per UK Estates ordinary share, a premium of 55.6 percent over the mid-market price of 22.5p prior to the announcement.
Ashquay is also offering 30 offer shares for every 13 UK Estates preference shares.

It also plans to raise up to 3.5 million stg via a rights issue. A total of 10.6 shares will be provisionally allotted at 33p per rights share on the basis of two rights shares for every five Ashquay shares.

"UK Estates' shares have persistently underperformed the sector and the FTSE All Share indices, whilst administrative costs have remained consistently high. We believe we have the proven track record to enhance the value of UK Estates," Derek Tughan, chairman of Ashquay said in a statement.
UK Estates owns retail and office property investments.
